landing.title: Understand your cycle, ask with confidence
landing.subtitle: CycleCare is an educational assistant that answers from reviewed sources, tracks your cycle, and prepares questions for your doctor — no diagnosis, no prescriptions.
landing.cta_login: I have an account — log in
landing.note: Sign-up is simple: a few questions help us understand you and tailor answers. Your data stays in your browser.
landing.f1_body: Every answer comes from reviewed knowledge and always ends with a consult-your-doctor line.
landing.f2_body: Log cycles and symptoms and see insights from your data — analysed locally, offline.
landing.f3_body: A summary of your cycles plus a question list to take to your appointment.
landing.f4_body: A language filter stops dangerous content and gives you the emergency number right away.
landing.disclaimer: CycleCare is educational only — it does not diagnose or prescribe.
